stepTitle: Identify the graph of $$y=\arccos(x/2)$$ \n Four graphs of inverse trigonometric functions arranged in a $$2$$ by $$2$$ grid. Panel A: a decreasing curve from the negative $$1$$ comma pi to the point $$1$$ comma $$0$$, defined on the closed interval from negative $$1$$ to $$1$$. Panel B: a decreasing curve from the point negative $$2$$ comma pi to the point $$2$$ comma $$0$$, defined on the closed interval from negative $$2$$ to $$2$$. Panel C: an increasing curve from the point $$0$$ comma negative pi over $$2$$ to the point $$2$$ comma pi over $$2$$, on the closed interval from $$0$$ to $$2$$. Panel D: an increasing S-shaped curve defined for all real numbers, with a horizontal dashed asymptote at $$y$$ equals negative pi below and approaching $$y$$ equals $$0$$ above, passing through the vertical axis at $$y$$ equals negative pi over $$2$$.
